title: Dark-photon-mediated pseudo-Dirac dark matter: fitting the LZ event
question: For pseudo-Dirac DM (splitting delta) coupled to a kinetically mixed dark photon (proton-only O1), what (m_chi, delta, m_A', eps^2 alpha_D) give one LZ event, how does the required cross-section compare with the pure Higgsino (P007), and is the parameter space compatible with dark-photon searches, the relic density and the chi2 lifetime?
headline_result: The dark photon fits any delta from 204 keV to delta_max with sigma_p(N=1) = 1.2e-42 (250 keV) to 2.3e-39 cm^2 (365 keV) at 1 TeV, 800x below the Higgsino at 300 keV; the proton-only spectrum converts to LZ's isoscalar intervals with a factor ~4 (not (A/Z)^2 = 5.9); required eps = 1e-7..1e-4 for m_A' = 0.3-10 GeV is far below dark-photon limits, but requiring chi2 to have decayed (chi2 -> chi1 nu nubar; a surviving chi2 gives 858-2.7e6 exothermic events) demands eps >~ 5e-6 and hence m_A' >~ 2.6 GeV at delta = 300 keV (0.5 GeV at 365 keV), excluding sub-GeV dark photons independently of alpha_D
model_or_mechanism: pseudo-Dirac fermion chi1/chi2 with kinetically mixed dark photon A' (Holdom mixing, coupling to protons), inelastic O1 with c_n=0 (WimPyDD c0=c1=c_p), heavy and light (q-dependent) mediator; chi chi -> A'A' relic; chi2 -> chi1 nu nubar via A'-Z mixing; exothermic chi2 down-scattering
result_type: computed (cross-sections, conversions, exothermic counts); estimated (chi2 width, relic alpha_D, recalled limits)
builds_on: LZ arXiv:2609.02823 (Theory, Fig. 6/S7, O1 supplement); P002, P003, P006, P007 (competing)
agent_tools: Read x21, Bash x24, Write x4, Edit x21, Skill x1 (dataviz), ToolSearch x1, TaskStop x1
software_and_packages: python 3.12.13; WimPyDD 2.0.4 (eft_hamiltonian incl. q-dependent WC, diff_rate per-stream kernels, streamed_halo_function); numpy 2.5.3; scipy 1.18.1 (erf/erfc); pandas 3.0.5; matplotlib 3.11.2; common/lzcommon.py
local_inputs: fulltext.tex (Theory l.44-60, Fig.6 caption, O1-as-cross-section supplement + Fig.S7); dossier; ledger; P002/P003/P007 papers; P007 N_events_grid.csv, lz_intervals_digitised.csv, details, scripts; P003_nreft_shapes.py; lzcommon.py; ENVIRONMENT_versions.txt
recalled_knowledge: 14 items: kinetic mixing and sigma_p formula, pseudo-Dirac off-diagonal current, PDG constants, (A/Z)^2, thermal <sigma v> 2.2e-26 (certain); <sigma v>(A'A') = pi alpha_D^2/m^2, A'-Z neutrino coupling, one-loop chi2->chi1 gamma vanishing, BaBar eps<1e-3 (likely); NA64/LHCb details, P003 N_max~3 (uncertain); NR three-body width derived
